Priya Menon: Quick sync — updating the quotas & metering page to document tiered burst-credit semantics. Need: tiny curl + python snippets that show the X-Redwood-Metering v2 header (and a legacy fallback), an iframe for the updated "Consumption by Tier" panel, and sign-off on the copy about when credits are applied.
Alex Chen: Ill do code snippets (curl + python requests). Keep them minimal. Will include fallback `x-metering-legacy`.
Jordan Lee: Dashboard moved last night. New URL: https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=ct-900. Use this iframe: <iframe src=\"https://console.redwood.ai/dashboards/usage/consumption-tiers?panelId=ct-900\" width=\"100%\" height=\"360\"></iframe>
Samir Patel: Wording tweak: replace "consumed on submit" -> "applied when a request completes successfully". Note: queued requests reserve credits until completion or timeout (released on timeout).
Priya Menon: adopting Samir's wording. Also we'll add a tiny 3-row example in prose showing events and credits_delta (start: reserve, success: deduct, timeout: release).
Alex Chen: Snippets (draft):
```bash
# curl example
curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -H \"X-Redwood-Metering: {\\\"client_id\\\":\\\"team-redwood\\\",\\\"job_id\\\":\\\"j-315\\\"}\" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd/fast","input":"Explain quota change."}'
```
```python
# python requests example
import os, requests
headers = {
  \"Authorization\": f\"Bearer {os.getenv('REDWOOD_KEY')}\",
  \"Content-Type\": \"application/json\",
  \"X-Redwood-Metering\": '{"client_id":"team-redwood","job_id":"j-315"}'
}
resp = requests.post(\"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\", json={\"model\":\"rwd/fast\",\"input\":\"Explain quota change.\"}, headers=headers)
print(resp.json().get('usage'))  # shows tokens, meter_rate, tier_applied
```
Alex Chen: Note: some shells require escaping the header quotes or using single-quoted header values. Legacy header example: `-H "x-metering-legacy: client=team-redwood"`.
Maria Gonzales: Spanish L10n for the sentence: "los créditos de ráfaga se aplican cuando la solicitud finaliza correctamente". I'll also check pluralization for "tokens" in the usage example.
